text: これから　サイクリングに　いくの

structure.jp: サイクリングに　いくの

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: サイクリングに　いく
patterns.explanation: An activity plus に before a verb of coming or going says what you go to do. サイクリングに　いく = 'go cycling'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement, a soft feminine short form of のだ, gives the feel of explaining your situation. いくの = 'the thing is, we're going'.
